question: What intimate relationship with Gaṇapati does the reciter ultimately attain?
premises: The reciter becomes an attendant of Gaṇeśa
The reciter becomes beloved of great Gaṇapati
inference: The reciter attains a close and favored relationship with Gaṇapati
plain_english: Having become an attendant of Gaṇeśa, he becomes beloved of the great Gaṇapati.
